scenario.name: financial_hardship
scenario.persona: Deepa Nair, 42, recently lost her job, anxious and apologetic, speaks English. The loan is 14 days overdue and she knows it.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly, then explain she lost her job and cannot pay right now. Ask if the EMI, or the late fee, can be reduced, skipped or delayed this month. Get a little emotional but stay civil. Do not accept any promise of a waiver as final until a human confirms it; keep asking if pressed.
scenario.opening: answers cautiously, sounds stressed once the topic comes up

turns.text: Hello, this is the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. Am I speaking with Deepa?
Yes, this is Deepa speaking. Who is this?

Hi Deepa, I'm the virtual assistant from Lumen Finance. It's regarding an important matter on your account. For your privacy, I just need to confirm it's you before I share any details. Could you tell me the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

Thank you, Deepa. Your personal loan EMI of nine thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October, and it is now fourteen days overdue. As per your loan terms, a late payment charge of five hundred rupees has been added. Would you be able to clear it today? I can send you a secure payment link on SMS or WhatsApp.
I... I'm sorry, I can't pay right now. I lost my job recently, so I don't have the money this month. Is there any way the EMI or the late fee can be reduced, skipped, or delayed?

I hear you. I'm really sorry to hear about your job, Deepa, and thank you for telling me. I can't change the amount or the dates myself. Is this something short-term, or is it hard to say right now? Please only share what feels comfortable. Our internal team will check this and arrange a call back for you. Is this the best number to reach you on?
It's hard to say right now, I'm still looking for work. Yes, this number is fine, but when will someone call me? I don't want more late fees adding up while I wait.

I understand your worry about more charges, Deepa. I can't promise exactly when the call will come, but our internal team will check this and arrange a call back for you. Please take care, Deepa, and thank you for talking with me.
Wait, so nothing is confirmed yet? Please make sure someone actually calls me about the fee, I don't want any surprises. Thank you.
Okay. I've noted your concern about the fees, Deepa. Our internal team will check this and arrange a call back for you.

result.message: Say you are sorry and thank them for telling you; you can't change the amount or dates yourself; gently ask if it is short-term, only what is comfortable; then say our internal team will check this and arrange a call back. Never say a colleague or the concerned team will call; never promise when, a waiver or any change.

args.notes: Borrower lost job recently, cannot pay now. Confirmed this is the best number to reach. Expressed concern about further late fees adding up while waiting for callback.

outcome.notes: Borrower lost job recently, cannot pay now. Confirmed this is the best number to reach. Expressed concern about further late fees adding up while waiting for callback.

guard_hits.original: Please take care, and thank you for talking with me.
